mapper.insert: INSERT INTO report (reporter_id, reported_user_id, reported_product_id, target_type, reason_code, description, handler_id, status, resolution_type, handler_memo) VALUES (#{reporterId}, #{reportedUserId}, #{reportedProductId}, #{targetType}, #{reasonCode}, #{description}, #{handlerId}, #{status}, #{resolutionType}, #{handlerMemo})
mapper.select: SELECT id, reporter_id, reported_user_id, reported_product_id, target_type, reason_code, description, handler_id, status, resolution_type, handler_memo, created_at, processed_at FROM report WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.update: UPDATE report SET status = #{status}, handler_id = #{handlerId}, resolution_type = #{resolutionType}, handler_memo = #{handlerMemo}, processed_at = #{processedAt} WHERE id = #{id}
